rows.TEXT: Highest lord of the dwarf lords, he is known for his intensity in battle and his courage in the face of overwhelming odds. He once fought seven days and nights against the mighty red dragon ARFURUZON to finally defeat him.

Every child trembles at the hearing of this most infamous name. This lord of hell is known for her blood thirsts. It is said that she once ate 1000 slaves at a banquet given by Bethrezen for a victory against the kingdom of light.

Known in his times as the mightiest of all adepts of the black art, this lord was slain by the inquisitor Vorgel who ended his reign of terror. He is now resurrected as an undead with the intention to subjugate every mortal to his will.
Loremaster"A scroll... it is a message written by Wotan's hand!"

Loremaster 
"It is written in pure gold! And this is what the wonderful letters read: 'Wotan cannot rule if no one listens, Hear the portent which by twilight glistens:' A portent?! Then it is written..."

"When dwarves no longer honor Wotan's runes, and beasts exploit ancestral boons.Hark! Lands besieged by heretic's curse,Dead walk again, fiends escape the earth!God cannot act; his reign forgot. In oblivion Wotan watches Ragnarok."
Loremaster"What can this mean? God cannot act... Wotan in oblivion... Ragnarok... The Twilight of the Gods! This will convince the Queen of our spiritual duties, indeed! I will go to her."

Yataa'Halli"We must stand united against the encroaching evils. Scouts have alerted me of hellish armies to the south and Undead troops North of here. Our Nation is strangled between these threats! But do not fear, The Dwarves are strong with Wotan."

Kings Guard 
"The mountains are infested with roaming wolves - beware... A pack of these wolves is capable of overwhelming a party of even our strength!"

Dwarf"The last time Mortis awakened the dead it was to slay our King Sturmir. She wrought vengeance for the death of her consort, Gallean, by Wotan's hands. And now? What hate burns in her unearthly mind now?"
Crossbowman"Gymner, brother of our fair Queen, died trying to prevent the infernal army from reaching us... but alas, the mountain that held Bethrezen hostage was breached."
Alchemist"Yataa'Halli seems to posses the same bravery as her brother Gymner!"
Crossbowman"Gymner, brother of our fair Queen, died trying to prevent the infernal army from reaching us... but alas, the mountain that held Bethrezen hostage was breached."
Alchemist"Yataa'Halli seems to posses the same bravery as her brother Gymner!"

Loremaster"Queen Yataa'Halli, your Highness. We crave your indulgence. We must make plans to honor Wotan, our 10 long years neglect has to be righted! It is not through war but through the rites that we can secure our position in this realm."

Yataa'Halli"Earthly struggles concern us most now, Loremasters. An expedition to the ceremony grounds is impossible, this would lead us into their domain! We must tame their forces first... I will not send my people at this time!"
Peasant"Thank you for ousting those - unnatural - creatures... We survived only by concealing ourselves!"

Squire"My city has been pillaged! My people are gone... fled most likely, the cowards! Thank goodness Mortis has no interest in human culture. My artwork and tapestries from foreign lands are untouched!"

Squire 
"Please, take this... Heal those who are weary."
Warrior"This city is well protected and safe... but I wonder if perhaps the inhabitants could have helped our cause. They were also suffering Mortis' wrath."
Axe Thrower"This city is huge, what we could do with a fortress of this size!"
Novice"There is not a soul left! Not even a stray dog... The whole place has been burnt - see, heat still rises from the stone floor!"
Wizard"Help, unpin me here! I am caught! Ah - thank you, brothers! None of my comrades survived; none had my skill at avoiding detection - through the use of magic, of course."
Wizard"I am grateful, let me help you."
Engineer"I had to flee! There was the clatter of hooves on cobblestones... a vision... the Valkyrie came..."
King's Guard"What are you saying? Speak clearly! You are trembling - what has frightened you so?"
Engineer"I fled... Please go south. And by the statue of Ymir... A vision came to me there, I was frightened. I cannot return - no, I cannot!!! But the Valkyrie's gift - it is there!"
Spearman"Dwarves, help us! The Undead have brought giant spiders back from death - and they threaten our city and yours!"

Yataa'Halli"We are making progress, the fiends are beginning to feel what Dwarven strength is! Invade further so finally we might pay homage to Wotan. Once the mortal danger has passed... Alas! a spiritual one arises."
Loremaster "Yataa'Halli, I have here a scroll, written by Wotan's hand. The Ragnarok is near! Wotan confirms it in this portent. He needs our strength!"
Yataa'Halli"How can we mortals help the Gods? They are the source of our strength, they gave us life!"

Loremaster"I see that Wotan's relationship to us is not that simple, if you permit me to say so, your highness. I have many questions, but one thing is clear... We must, as the portent says, honor the ancestral runes. Wotan grows weak!"
King's Guard"We have struck another victory! Keep pushing the evil armies back, and the Clans will be unstoppable. For Wotan!"
Yataa'Halli"Keep on, Dwarves! Make inroads into the deepest territories of these fiends!"
Yataa'Halli"The Clans!!! We have overcome! Our adversaries have been quelled for the time being, well done... But we must be more vigilant in the future and have our scouts on the alert."
Crossbowman"Mortis' minions have taken shelter here. Let us flush them out of this area, before they take hold closer to Dwarven lands."
My items are the best in the realm.
Dwarf"What a terrifying encounter! As a young Dwarf I heard folk tales of Vampires. I never imagined that they truly existed until Mortis' undead armies made their attack in the Great Wars."
I think my magical library can be of some help to you.
Loremaster"I see... This shrine is dedicated to the worship of a forgotten God. Will this someday be the fate of our Dwarven civilization?"
Dwarf"Careful of the broken glass scattered about. Shattered vials and bottles, which may have once contained evil elixirs! Ah! Here is one bottle which has survived the barbarous Greenskins."
Come in, I will make worthy fighters out of your frail soldiers.
Alchemist"Ugh, the greenskins live in the most brutal conditions! I found this in the entranceway. It is old, but we could sell it for a tidy sum."
Dwarf"Loremaster, please take a look at this item."
Loremaster"Yes, with the aid of this item we can use the demons own magic against them... what wonderful revenge that is!"
King's Guard"Armies once surveyed the land from this vantage point. Let us descend, the wind is fierce here."
Engineer"Horrible! Let us leave this cursed place... I did not think we would get out of there in one piece."
King's Guard"We can use this city to minister to our wounded..."
Engineer"The ownership of this city puts the enemy in easy reach!"
Dwarf"It is fortunate that we took over this Greenskin stronghold!"
